sections.label: EFFECT
sections.html: Broken applies while your shared Manifestation Wound track is full. A Broken character cannot enter Full Manifestation. Ordinary Calling Actions and Reactions remain available.

sections.label: RECOVERY
sections.html: Removing at least one Manifestation Wound ends Broken. Ordinary Condition removal does not repair the shared track.

sections.label: REMOVAL
sections.html: Effects that remove ordinary Conditions do not remove Specialty Conditions unless they explicitly say so.
